text: ⛽️ Drydock: Diff Your npm Tarballs Before You Publish From a Preact core team member comes a tool to diff built npm tarballs against the last published version, flagging install scripts, network access and new binaries. It can then gate your Actions publish job or watch npm's new staged publishing flow. Jovi De Croock
